title: macOS Endpoint Management Baseline in Microsoft Intune
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (macOS + Microsoft Intune/Entra; configuration/identity/security work, live-fleet care).
White-label; Apple/Microsoft console internals authored click-by-click from public docs; anything uncertain flagged, not invented.
hook: Give every Mac a consistent, compliant Intune baseline
problem: Macs enrolled in Intune without a deliberate baseline drift into inconsistent, non-compliant states. This solution establishes the foundational macOS management baseline in Microsoft Intune — configuration profiles (settings catalog and custom .mobileconfig), device restrictions, compliance policies, and software-update management — so every Mac meets corporate standards for security, performance, and user experience, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the macOS management model in Intune (MDM protocol, config profiles, settings catalog vs custom .mobileconfig, compliance, update management) and the standard deployment model.
Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune + Entra licensing, APNs certificate, enrollment method, Entra groups, a pilot group) with how to verify and implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact ordered steps to build the named baseline configuration profiles, restrictions, compliance policies, and macOS software-update policy, assign to a pilot, validate, and expand.
5 PowerShell scripts — baseline discovery, per-device applied-state validation, a config/compliance coverage report, safe remediation of drifted devices, and a target-group builder (Microsoft Graph).
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices for naming, settings catalog, and update rings.
short: Establish the foundational macOS management baseline in Intune — config profiles, restrictions, compliance, and update management — so every Mac meets corporate standards, deployed pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
